title: Electric Sorcerer
description: A middle-aged man in military camouflage and cap stands centered, both hands extended emitting vibrant purple and blue lightning. To his right, a glowing golden female figure made of cracked light floats in the sky. Behind them is a dramatic cityscape featuring a large domed building under a swirling cosmic sky filled with stars and nebulae.
prompt: A determined middle-aged man wearing a camouflage military uniform and cap stands in the foreground casting powerful purple and blue lightning from both hands, a glowing golden ethereal female figure composed of cracks and light floating beside him, dramatic city skyline with a large domed building in the background, swirling cosmic starry sky with nebulae and dramatic clouds at sunset, highly detailed cinematic fantasy painting
